title: CSV export uses semicolons as separators in some locales
description: Organizations with a German or French locale got CSV exports separated by semicolons instead of commas.

title: Late fees calculated on the tax amount
description: Late fees were calculated on the invoice total including tax instead of the subtotal, overcharging clients.

title: Invoice emails with attachments delayed up to 2 hours
description: Invoice emails with attachments larger than 5 MB were queued and could arrive up to 2 hours late. Superseded by the 2.0.0 email service.

title: Reports time out above 5,000 invoices
description: Standard reports for organizations with more than 5,000 invoices timed out after 60 seconds.

title: Currency rounding error on invoice totals
description: Invoices in JPY and other zero-decimal currencies rounded totals incorrectly, overcharging customers by up to 1 unit per line item.

title: Dashboard fails to load for accounts with 500+ contacts
description: Large accounts saw a blank dashboard due to an unpaginated contacts query timing out.

title: Exchange rates not refreshed on weekends
description: Daily exchange rates were not refreshed on Saturdays and Sundays, so weekend invoices used Friday's rate.

title: Invoice numbering skips a number after a draft is deleted
description: Deleting a draft invoice consumed its number, leaving a gap in the INV- sequence.

title: Archived tax rates hidden on existing drafts
description: Draft invoices that used a tax rate archived later showed an empty tax field instead of the archived rate.

title: Receipt OCR misreads handwritten totals
description: OCR accuracy on handwritten receipts is below 40%; typed/printed receipts are unaffected. Documented as a known limitation.

title: Recurring invoices skip a cycle across DST changes
description: Recurring invoice schedules calculated in local time skipped a billing cycle when daylight-saving time shifted, causing missed invoices for some customers.

title: Receipt scanning rotates landscape receipts
description: Receipts photographed in landscape were rotated 90 degrees before OCR, so the amount was often missed.

title: Payment reminder sent twice when the send window crosses midnight
description: Client-level reminders with a send window that crossed midnight UTC were sent twice.

title: Recurring invoice preview shows the wrong currency symbol
description: The preview of upcoming recurring invoices showed the base currency symbol for clients billed in another currency. The invoices themselves were correct.

title: Expense CSV import rejects DD/MM/YYYY dates
description: Importing expenses from CSV failed for files with dates written as DD/MM/YYYY.

title: Client portal login loop on Safari
description: Safari users were redirected back to the login page after successful authentication due to a cookie SameSite misconfiguration.

title: API v2 rate limit headers missing
description: API v2 responses did not include X-RateLimit-* headers, making it hard for integrators to back off proactively.

title: Bulk void leaves payment reminders scheduled
description: Invoices voided with a bulk action kept their scheduled payment reminders, so clients got reminders for void invoices.

title: API v2 list endpoints return next_cursor on the last page
description: List endpoints returned a non-null next_cursor on the last page, so integrations made one extra empty request.

title: Portal Pay now button hidden for partially paid invoices
description: Clients could not pay the rest of a partially paid invoice from the client portal because the Pay now button was hidden.

title: Idempotency-Key ignored on POST /v2/payments
description: Retries of POST /v2/payments with the same Idempotency-Key created duplicate payments. Other endpoints were not affected.

title: Custom report builder times out on 3+ year date ranges
description: Reports spanning more than 3 years of transactions time out instead of paginating results.

title: Bank reconciliation auto-match fails for multi-currency accounts
description: Auto-match in bank reconciliation does not convert foreign-currency transactions before comparing amounts, so multi-currency accounts see most transactions left unmatched.

title: PDF export drops the second page of long invoices
description: Invoices with more than 25 line items export as a single-page PDF, silently dropping remaining line items.

title: Minor: report builder date picker shows wrong first day of week
description: The date-range picker in the custom report builder always starts weeks on Sunday, ignoring the organization's locale setting.
